full_name: Mitchell B. Merback | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Fusing art history and historical anthropology, Mitchell B. Merback, an associate professor of art history at DePauw University, examines a wide range of issues concerning the devotional and cultic arts of the Christian Late Middle Ages and Renaissance.
